observations: Settled alignment and maturity controls are unobstructed in the accepted rerun. Alignment sits below the last right personality row and above profile/footer/navigation without collision.
The creative baby visibly moves from Neutral toward Hero; final header saysHero+80.2 and the thumb matches. Fixed head/eyes and compact limbs remain coherent in the portrait and world views.

Maturity percentage and thumb visibly move through an intermediate requested value, settle at25.0% and then99.0% for the child; the boundary hint remains readable. Blue young orb and pink older highRun orb are uniform semantic pigments with ordinary face lighting.
Dark adult remains Dark−100.0 with explicit ADULT ALIGNMENT:LOCKED header and readonly tap reason; maturity changes25.0%→100.0%, with header remaining adult and progressing YoungAdult→FullyAdult.
Survival shows ALIGNMENT:VIEW and a readonly explanation; Neutral0 and approximately80% maturity remain after forged requests. No Creative maturity-edit hint is shown.

All three post-reload front/left/back sets show intact visible eyes, compact extremities and plausible marker placement. The older Dark Run model remains its existing form; this review does not claim a new Dark morphology implementation.
Native server log records stagePreserved=true and exact entityNBT reload for all three cases. Child/Survival tiny growth drift is normal resumedaging, not a drag-induced transition.

Intermediate drag screenshots intentionally retain the production hover tooltip and pending-value line. Settled screenshots park the actual rendered pointer; no production tooltip rendering was suppressed.
limitations: No physical phone touchscreen was exercised. Input uses actual screen mouse handlers and payloads, plus a dev-only invocation of the native MouseHandler cursor callback for deterministic capture position.
Only this1440×900 / GUI-scale2 visual layout was inspected live. Pure geometry tests cover narrower scales, but they are not phone screenshots.
Bottom feedback and labels are small; the adult lock also has a permanent header and tooltip. Readability should be checked on the user phone.
No audio listening, independent remote multiplayer, fullmodpack, arbitraryshader or full lifecycle observation is established by this audit.
recapture_reason: First pass and initial UI rerun had hover tooltips obscuring settled readouts. Final helper replays requested native cursor coordinates just before GameRenderer.render and records actual ScreenEvent mouse coordinates. Only final25PNGs are accepted here.
